en: How do I add ready-made questions for customers?

steps: Add a question: name up to 24 chars, answer up to 1024, Arabic + English
edgeCases: WhatsApp lists max 10 rows; fixed rows (order, location, person) leave 7 questions
Customer sees it on hello, "menu", or an unanswered message
Menu off or empty = no change
Arabic/RTL: phone numbers, URLs and API keys stay LTR inside RTL text
Mobile: rail collapses to a bottom/side nav; the orders pane opens as a sheet
gaps: Some links say "Settings" but the rail has no Settings item; screen is called Bot
